law: Free/OSS First. These tones live in the repo. No paid API.
chain: HP(LowCut+TIGHT) → Tight shelf → Body peak → Drive → tanh(MORPH) → Bite → Air → Gate → Delay/Reverb → Trim
oversample_note: 4x on the shaper unless the preset says otherwise. ADAA is native VST, not the browser shaper.

THALL.gate_behavior: fast chug mute, hysteresis 0.58, stay open only when GATE near 0
THALL.gain_structure: drive 0.72+GAIN^2*5.8 into tanh amount 1.4+GAIN^2*22, modern/asym morph 40
THALL.target: tight palm mute, pick attack at Bite, little room

DJENT.gate_behavior: aggressive close on stops, short decay
DJENT.gain_structure: higher GAIN, morph toward symmetric tanh (odd harmonics)

DOOM.gate_behavior: mostly open, slow bloom, do not chop tails
DOOM.gain_structure: lower GAIN, morph toward asymmetric (even harmonics)
DOOM.target: thick low-mids, long notes, wetter delay

BLACK_METAL.gate_behavior: medium, keep tremolo wash, no djent chop
BLACK_METAL.gain_structure: high GAIN, morph near modern, Air up
BLACK_METAL.target: ice on top, scooped body, hiss is the point

CLEAN_AMBIENT.gain_structure: almost no clip, morph to asym for soft even harmonics, SPACE wet

MODERN_METAL.gate_behavior: studio mute, not as snappy as DJENT
MODERN_METAL.target: works in a mix without extra EQ
